purpose: Review source-to-cast identity and every depicted available cast kind, then retain two ordinary Lamentations preparations. Memory-only text diagnostic; no production access or images.
authorization: Owner said ok continue. Existing evaluation allowance only; no increase or transfer from preparation/smoke.
method: Six direct candidate reviews in review-cases.json order, then two cold ordinary prepareMoment operations for retained s034. Both historical priest plans and their old clean reviews remain unchanged. Controls and required reports are frozen before calls. No paid baseline repeat, tuning or rerun. Same production model/provider/settings, malformed retry and one semantic re-plan. Fresh memory store for each preparation.

acceptance.review: All six direct reviews complete; each negative reports every required kind and ID; all three positive controls have no problems. Extra negative reports are retained and judged explicitly.
acceptance.pipeline: Both preparations store acceptable source-supported scenes, with zero flawed or uncertain stores. Refusal is not repair. Unblinded operator scoring; retain every ambiguous call and its effect on the verdict.
acceptance.release: A small selected diagnostic cannot establish population reliability, repair the failed broader pipeline gate, or prove image compliance. Broader ordinary/hard-moment text, images, current latency and owner acceptance remain required.

retryPolicy: One-shot. Reserve before every actual request and reject requests whose estimated maximum cost exceeds reserve. Stop on unknown usage, provider error, request drift, unavailable review or cap/headroom; retain partial operations. No retries beyond ordinary production behavior. Two pipelines may not both fit the remaining allowance; an incomplete run fails the diagnostic and does not authorize more spend.
audit: Commit candidate, protocol, exact direct inputs, source/fixture hashes and dry-run first-request hashes before paid calls; record frozen commit. Fresh provider pricing/balance preflight. Offline replay checks every request, response, result and per-call usage against the ledger. Ignored generated work bytes are pinned in the committed manifest, other inputs in git. Shared account-balance deltas are not operation cost.
